title: Digitized
description: Vanilla Minecraft with a digital storage solution.
body: Minecraft has continued to expand it's item list for years on years now. However the storage issue has never quite been resolved. Enter applied energistics. A staple mod for every modpack to help players stay organized and automate things never thought possible. Why not add it to vanilla minecraft? That's what this pack does as well as change the recipes to only include vanilla items to help keep the feel of the pack vanilla.
